def placeholders(self, n_steps):
        self.inputs = [tf.placeholder(tf.float32, shape=[None, self.dim])
                       for _ in range(n_steps)]
        self.masks = [tf.ones_like(x) for x in self.inputs]

def render(self, table):
        widths = [max(len(str(row[i])) for row in table.rows)
                  for i in range(table.ncols)]
        return widths

def tokenize(lines, vocab):
    ids = [[vocab.get(w, vocab['<unk>']) for w in line.split()]
           for line in lines]
    return ids
